title: Quantitative and Computational Biosciences
description:
Prerequisite: Minimum grade of C- in (MATH136 or MATH140) and (BSCI160, BSCI170 or BIOE120).
Recommended: Coding experience in R, Python, or MATLAB is strongly recommended.
Restriction: Junior standing or higher.
Jointly offered with: BIOL706.
Credit only granted for: BIOL706, BIPH706 or BSCI435.
